about: How much tape a label takes, worked by hand for the label maker in device, as /api/capabilities serves it. The firmware and the panel each do these sums, in src/Tape.h and data/tape.js, and test/test_tape/test_tape.cpp and test/panel/tape.test.js hold both to these cases. mm is that length to a tenth of a millimetre. The device's gauge rounds the same product down to a whole millimetre.
